## /rebar-debug Phase 1 — Step 0 orientation + Stage 1 dossier

Fresh worktree `debug-store-growth` off `origin/main`. Measurements done in scratch blobless clones from `git@github.com:navapbc/rebar.git` (git 2.55), NOT the polluted primary checkout.

### Step 0
- **0(a) sweep:** this ticket (a453, open) is the reproducible signal. Prior art = CLOSED bug `absurd-zoometric-bobwhite` (f9ee) — the >1 GiB *full-clone* investigation, **blob-dominated**. Open growth tickets: `dynamic-curium-sponge` 341a, `apparent-sighted-cockatoo` 4520, `polite-antivirus-bedbug` 536b, `epidemic-chocolaty-imago` 0754, plus data-disk `wakeful-ordinary-chicken` 5a05. a453 already `relates_to` f9ee — I am **keeping `relates_to`, not adding `duplicates`**, because a453 is a *distinct mechanism* (blobless = trees) from f9ee (full clone = blobs); it is a continuation of the same growth family, not the same defect.
- **0(b) floor:** no version quoted; `created_at` 1788023949407749278 ns → floor `git rev-list -1 --before=@1788023949 origin/main` = **36ae045f41c3**. `git log 36ae045f..origin/main -- .github/workflows/verify-identity.yml` is **empty** → the workflow/limit did not move since the report; "the construct changed" is a **closed question**.
- **0(c):** worktree HEAD `1f1606b93965` == `origin/main`. Current.

Triage: **full protocol** (the CI-vs-f9ee blobless/full discriminator was a live ambiguity).

### Stage 1 — reproduction & measurements

**The guard measures the CODE checkout, before tickets is mounted.** `verify-identity.yml` runs the `size-pack` check at its FIRST step — right after `actions/checkout@v7` (`filter: blob:none`, `fetch-depth: 0`) — *before* the later "Mount tickets branch as a worktree" step. With `fetch-depth: 0`, `actions/checkout` fetches **all refs**, which pulls the giant `tickets` orphan branch into that first pack. So the 481 MiB is a **blobless (commits+trees, NO blobs) pack dominated by the `tickets` branch.**

**Reproduced (scratch, blobless):**
| Fetch | size-pack |
|---|---|
| `main` only, full history, blobless | **5.86 MiB** |
| `main` + `tickets`, blobless | **463 MiB** |
| ALL heads+tags, blobless (faithful `fetch-depth:0`) | **475,211 KiB (464 MiB)** |
| CI observed (run 33253701193, sha 5fb69334) | 492,830 KiB (481 MiB) |

The 464 vs 481 gap = further `tickets` growth since the CI sha. **main-only is 5.86 MiB → the entire mass is the `tickets` branch.**

**Object-type composition** (`git cat-file --batch-all-objects --batch-check='%(objecttype) %(objectsize:disk)'`):
- **tree: 428,022 objects = 401.0 MiB (~90%)**
- commit: 238,138 objects = 44.3 MiB (~10%)
- **blob: 0** (filtered)

**Repack does NOT help.** `git repack -adf --window=250 --depth=250` on the blobless clone → **558 MiB** (trees 495.7, commits 44.7) — it *grew*. Trees have no blob delta-bases in a blobless pack, so gc/repack cannot shrink this. This is genuine tree-object mass, not a packing artifact.

**Contrast with f9ee** (full clone, ~08-23): pack 322 MiB = blobs 235 + trees 60 + commits 27. Its blobless component (trees+commits, optimally packed) ≈ **87 MiB — just under 100**. So the prior blob/comment-echo findings do **not** explain this CI failure; **trees do.**

### The 08-23 boundary is a STEP CHANGE (proven)
`git log origin/tickets` per-day author-date counts: steady **~1.5–3K commits/day through 08-20**, then a ~10× jump: **08-21=22,986, 08-22=18,003, 08-23=19,497, 08-24=16,669, 08-25=15,695, 08-26=18,533, 08-27=12,891, 08-28=9,239**. ~120K commits — **over half the entire 235,260-commit branch — were created in 8 days.** The CI crossed the (unchanged) 100 MiB limit on 08-23 as this surge's commit+tree mass accumulated.

**Surge composition** (08-21→08-29, 119,671 commits): **27,072 auto-reconcile merge commits** + **81,206 enrichment-quartet events** (CLAIM_ENRICH 23,006, TICKET_DIGEST 19,580, DONE_ENRICH 19,570, ENQUEUE_ENRICH 19,050) + ~9,400 other. Branch totals: 235,260 commits / **38,022 merges (16%)**.

**Re-enrichment loop:** 19,050 ENQUEUE_ENRICH for only **1,239 distinct tickets = ~15 cycles/ticket** in 8 days (top tickets 22–29×). Mechanism: `digest_sidecar` freshness hashes `title+description+comment bodies` (`DIGEST_HASH_VERSION=1`, unchanged since 08-05 — **no schema-bump mass-invalidation**). So every material ticket edit flips the digest stale → one 4-event enrichment cycle + a merge on push. The surge is a **~10× rise in organic ticket-write activity, fanned out ~4–5× by enrichment + merges**, every event a permanent commit+tree on an unbounded, never-reclaimed branch.

## /rebar-debug Phase 1 EXIT — Root Cause Analysis (proven)

### Proven root cause
The "Verify Authorship Identity" guard fails because `actions/checkout@v7` with `fetch-depth: 0` fetches **all refs**, pulling the `tickets` orphan branch into a **blobless** pack (`filter: blob:none`) whose size (481 MiB observed / 464 MiB reproduced) is **~90% Git TREE objects** (428,022 trees = 401 MiB) and ~10% commits (238,138 = 44 MiB), with **zero blobs**. Every append-only ticket-write commit mints new tree objects (root + each path subtree); trees delta poorly and — with blobs filtered out — have no blob delta-bases, so `gc`/`repack` cannot shrink the pack (I confirmed: aggressive `repack -adf` *grew* it to 558 MiB). The tree/commit mass grows ~linearly and unbounded with commit count, because the event-sourced store **retains all history permanently** (no causal-stability GC; compaction only renames folded events to `.retired`, keeping their objects).

**The 08-23 crossing = STEP CHANGE, not gradual drift** (proven above): a ~10× surge in `tickets` commits from 08-21 (≈120K commits — >half the branch — in 8 days), 88% of the non-merge surge being the enrichment quartet (ENQUEUE/CLAIM/DONE_ENRICH + TICKET_DIGEST) fanned ~4–5× per edit plus 27K auto-reconcile merges. The static 100 MiB limit (`REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=102400`, unchanged since it was introduced in `16a1a385`, 2026-08-01) was crossed as this surge's tree mass accumulated. No workflow, limit, or digest-schema change occurred near 08-23 — the growth is organic ticket-write activity meeting a pre-existing threshold.

### 5a05 (data-disk) — shared driver + independent component
5a05 **shares** this driver (the on-disk `tickets` store carries the same commits+trees). But the on-disk full store **also** carries the ~235 MB of blobs (f9ee's comment-echo bloat) + working-tree/`.retired` retained files that the blobless pack excludes, so its growth is **larger and blob-inclusive**. Its acute 08-26 climb to 88% is ~5 days after the 08-21 surge start — consistent with sustained fill. A possible **independent component** (Gerrit review artifacts / server-side packs on the same volume) is plausible but **unverifiable read-only** and out of scope; flagged on 5a05.

### Which f9ee mechanisms are still active — and which matter for a453
| f9ee mechanism | Still active? | Drives blobless CI pack (a453)? | Drives on-disk (5a05)? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Comment-echo blob bloat (32,767-char Jira echoes) | Yes | **No** (blobs filtered) | Yes |
| `.bridge_state` churn (blobs) | Yes | **No** (blobs filtered) | Yes |
| Permanent `.retired` retention / no causal-stability GC | Yes | **Yes** (retains commits+trees) | Yes |
| Merge topology (auto-reconcile merges) | Yes, amplified (16% of branch) | **Yes** (commit+tree mass) | Yes |
| **Enrichment-quartet fan-out (new dominant driver)** | Yes | **YES — dominant** | Yes |

For the **blobless CI pack, TREES dominate**; f9ee's blob findings are irrelevant to a453. For the **on-disk store, blobs still dominate** (f9ee unchanged) plus the new tree mass.

### Defect legitimacy + attribution (caused_by)
**Legitimate defect — `incomplete-implementation`.** The guard fails-closed exactly as designed (`42eb` "fail closed"); the defect is the **missing bound on historical Git-object growth** that the standing epics were meant to supply. **Attribution = scope-of-work OMISSION, no single introducing commit** (searches: no digest-schema bump since 08-05; no workflow/limit change since 08-01; surge is organic write activity). Chain: correctness fix **`be8a0c0`** (Gerrit 989, bug 8185) deliberately **removed enrichment-event pruning** to fix the append-union invariant — correct in itself — and created an unbounded-retention problem that **`apparent-sighted-cockatoo` (4520)** was opened to bound but which **remains `idea` (never built)**. Recording `caused_by → 4520` (scope-of-work force): 4520 explicitly owns bounding ENQUEUE/CLAIM/DONE_ENRICH + TICKET_DIGEST growth — the proven 88% driver.

**CRITICAL caveat on 4520:** its own AC#6 **disclaims Git-history/pack reclamation** ("bounds hot/live event lookup and working-tree growth WITHOUT rewriting or deleting committed UUID events"). So **4520 as currently scoped would NOT shrink the blobless pack** — it bounds live-tree/lookup cost, not historical objects. Fixing a453 needs 4520 **extended** or **paired** with historical reclamation (536b causal-stability GC, or a one-time rewrite like `censual-organic-mouflon`), OR a pure-CI checkout change. This split-ownership gap is the key remediation finding below.

### Recommended remediation directions (NOT implemented — Phase 1 only)
Ranked; **pure-CI** vs **behavior/policy**:

1. **[pure-CI, fastest, but ASSESS PURPOSE] CI-only shallow/partial checkout in verify-identity.** The guard fetches full `tickets` history only as a side effect of `fetch-depth: 0` on the code checkout. **But the workflow's job is authorship verification, which walks history** — a shallow/`fetch-depth:1` clone may not verify full-history authorship. *Do not blindly shallow-clone.* Options that preserve purpose: don't fetch `tickets` at all for the identity job (checkout only `main`/the code refs → 5.86 MiB), or scope the pack-size guard to the refs the job actually needs. **Needs a purpose assessment before adopting.** Maps to `42eb`-family CI-cost work.
2. **[policy, kicks the can] Raise `REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB`.** Trivial, buys time, but growth is ~linear and unbounded — re-breaches. Only as a stopgap paired with (1) or (3).
3. **[behavior, real fix — dominant driver] Bound enrichment fan-out / retention — `apparent-sighted-cockatoo` 4520.** Coalesce/deduplicate the ~15×/ticket re-enrichment cycles and the quartet fan-out so ~120K-commit surges can't recur. **Reduces future growth rate**; does **not** reclaim existing pack (per its AC#6). The correct *prevention* owner.
4. **[behavior, reclaims existing mass] Causal-stability GC to reclaim `.retired` — `polite-antivirus-bedbug` 536b.** The only direction that can *shrink* the historical pack in place; needs the missing causal-stability proof before it can rewrite objects out. Highest effort, highest payoff for a453's actual symptom.
5. **[budget/measurement] Add a blobless-pack footprint budget — `epidemic-chocolaty-imago` 0754.** Make this failure observable/owned before it re-breaches.
6. **NOTE — NOT the fix: `dynamic-curium-sponge` 341a.** It bounds maintenance *latency* (gc pause), not pack *size*; and I proved repack cannot shrink the blobless pack. Do not route a453's remediation here.

Recommended combination: **(1) to unblock CI immediately** (with the purpose assessment), **(3)+(4) to actually bound+reclaim store growth**, **(5) to keep it observed**. (1) is pure-CI; (3)(4)(5) are behavior/policy decisions for the standing epics — handing back per scope.

### Phase-1 confirmation
Stayed in **Phase 1 (Understand) only**: no production/workflow fix written, nothing pushed to Gerrit, no ticket closed. RCA written to a453 (this + the dossier comment); cross-noted on 5a05; `caused_by` link recorded. Remediation handed back as ranked directions.

Guard authorship verification with exact object-database snapshots so identity scans cannot lazily fetch promisor objects.' => The 100 MiB limit is a DELIBERATE budget on the tickets-history blobless checkout (a growth canary), NOT an accidental inclusion of the tickets branch. The workflow also GENUINELY needs full tickets history (the 'Mount tickets branch' step fetches it un-shallow for commit-ancestry-scoped signature verification). CONSEQUENCE: remediation option (1) 'scope verify-identity's checkout to drop tickets' is INVALID — it would silence an intentional budget/canary while the store is genuinely over budget (independently confirmed by the data-disk-high alarm 5a05). Valid levers are only: raise the budget (stopgap leash), bound growth (4520 apparent-sighted-cockatoo), and reclaim existing mass (536b polite-antivirus-bedbug causal-stability GC — the ONLY lever that returns the pack under budget without raising it).

## /rebar-debug resolution — a453 symptom already remediated on origin/main (no new fix authored)

Resuming this in_progress bug. The decisive new fact the prior Phase-1 RCA did not yet have: **the red-gate symptom is already fixed on `origin/main`, and the gate is green again.**

### The gate is GREEN
- Scheduled run **33285210617** — sha `454f875e05d9`, 2026-08-30T01:14:19Z — **success**. (The three prior scheduled runs 33269532975 / 33253701193 / 33239620291 were red; this is the first green after the bridge landed.)
- `git merge-base --is-ancestor d0bcd6202789 454f875e05d9` → true; the green sha carries the raised budget (`REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB: 563200`).

### What fixed it (not me)
Commit **`d0bcd6202789`** (`rebar-ticket: a8ba-a2a3-e9c8-4ffa` — task *"W3 bridge: raise verify-identity pack budget to 550 MiB while 536b reclaim lands"*, landed 2026-08-29 16:31, now **closed**) raised `REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB` from 102400 (100 MiB) to **563200 (550 MiB)** — ~70 MiB headroom over the ~481 MiB blobless tickets pack — with a self-documenting comment naming the restore ticket `fluorspar-comparable-zeren` (0894-b9b8-6590-4904). It also moved the one coupled test expectation (`test_pack_guard_contract`) in lockstep; the guard's fail-closed control flow is unchanged.

### Why this satisfies a453's acceptance criteria
- **AC1** (size-pack reproduced & attributed by object type/ref) — met by the Stage-1 dossier: 481 MiB observed / 464 MiB reproduced, **~90% Git tree objects** (428,022 trees ≈ 401 MiB), ~10% commits, **zero blobs** (filtered).
- **AC2** (root cause of the 08-23 crossing: growth vs limit-too-low) — met: a **step-change** ~10× surge in `tickets` commits from 08-21 (≈120K commits — over half the branch — in 8 days), organic ticket-write activity fanned by the enrichment quartet + auto-reconcile merges, crossing a **static, unchanged** budget. Not a code regression; no workflow/limit/digest-schema change occurred near 08-23.
- **AC3** (either the limit is intentionally re-set **with justification**, or growth reclaimed, **with evidence of a passing run**) — **met via the "limit intentionally re-set" branch**: a8ba's justified, reversible bridge + green run 33285210617.

AC#3 is an explicit disjunction and the re-set-limit arm is satisfied, so a453 is resolved **by its own contract**.

### Independent verification of the load-bearing RCA facts (I re-checked, did not just trust prior comments)
- The guard measures the **tickets-inclusive** pack: `actions/checkout@v7` runs `filter: blob:none, fetch-depth: 0` (all refs → pulls the `tickets` orphan branch) and the `size-pack` guard runs **before** the separate "Mount tickets branch" step. Confirmed by reading `verify-identity.yml`.
- The 100 MiB limit is a **deliberate canary**, not accidental: introducing commit `16a1a385` (ticket 037b, 2026-08-01) — *"Add blobless fetches and executable pack-size budgets. Guard authorship verification with exact object-database snapshots so identity scans cannot lazily fetch promisor objects."*
- No workflow/limit change caused the 08-23 crossing: `git log --since=2026-08-20 origin/main -- .github/workflows/verify-identity.yml` shows only the **post-hoc** bridge `d0bcd6202789`.

### Why no new code fix is warranted (and would be wrong)
The verifier is not broken and the blobless pack is not a compatibility bug — the guard is a growth canary that **fired correctly** on genuine store growth (independently corroborated by the data-disk-high alarm 5a05). The only levers are **policy/design changes**: (a) raise the budget — a *weakening of the growth canary*, already done as an explicit temporary bridge by a8ba; (b) reclaim historical Git objects — epic **536b** (causal-stability GC); then restore the budget to 100 MiB — task **0894**. Authoring another change here would be redundant with a8ba and would not shrink the pack. Per the debug protocol's not-a-bug/policy guard and the standing instruction to escalate authorship-verification policy changes, the budget-raise decision was correctly made *outside* this bug (a8ba, reviewed + landed), and the durable reclaim is owned by 536b/0894.

### Attribution
`caused_by → 4520-11a6-7458-454f` (apparent-sighted-cockatoo) already recorded (explicit). Chain: correctness fix `be8a0c0` deliberately removed enrichment-event pruning (correct in itself) and created an unbounded-retention obligation that 4520 was opened to bound but which remains unbuilt; the growth-management plan was incomplete. Scope-of-work omission, no single introducing commit → `plan_defect` escape.

### Disposition
Closing a453 as resolved: gate green, all ACs met via a8ba's landed bridge. The persisting underlying growth (bridge, not cure) is tracked by **536b** (reclaim) + **0894** (restore budget to 100 MiB). Linking a453 `relates_to` a8ba (resolving change) and 0894 (restore follow-up) for traceability.

## Problem

The scheduled **Verify Authorship Identity** workflow (`.github/workflows/verify-identity.yml`, job `verify-identity (authenticated-authorship gate)`) fails at the step **"Fail closed if the blobless checkout pack exceeds its limit"**. The guard compares `git count-objects -v` `size-pack:` against `REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB` (verify-identity.yml:47, value `102400` KiB = 100 MiB) and fails closed when exceeded.

Decisive log (run 33253701193, sha `5fb693345b0c`):
```
REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB: 102400
##[error]checkout pack is 492830 KiB; limit is 102400 KiB
##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.
```
So the checkout pack is **492830 KiB ≈ 481 MiB**, ~4.8× the 100 MiB limit.

## This is a regression, not a chronic config

`Verify Authorship Identity` history (schedule, ~4×/day) shows a clean green→red boundary:
- last success: `2026-08-23T01:20:35Z`
- first failure: `2026-08-23T07:07:44Z`
- red on **every** run since (12+ consecutive at time of filing, through 2026-08-29T12:55).

So the pack crossed the 100 MiB threshold around 2026-08-23 and has kept growing. Failing runs in window: 33239620291, 33253701193 (both sha `5fb693345b0c`), plus the same failure every prior scheduled run back to 2026-08-23.

## Root cause hypothesis

Repo/tickets-branch object growth pushed the blobless checkout pack past the CI limit. This correlates with tickets-store growth — see closed P1 bug `absurd-zoometric-bobwhite` (f9ee-5ad5-4a78-4147, "tickets branch/store exceeds 1 GiB after history reclaim"). The reclaim there targeted a fresh clone ≤150 MB, but the CI gate's blobless checkout is now 481 MiB, so either growth resumed post-reclaim or the 100 MiB limit no longer reflects the store's steady-state size. It also plausibly correlates with the gerrit data-disk-high alarm / AWS data-disk sweep (repo growth on the box).

## What needs deciding

1. Is 481 MiB expected steady-state (limit too low → raise `REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB` deliberately), or is this unbounded growth that needs another reclaim/gc / packing-strategy fix?
2. Quantify current pack composition (blob vs tree vs history, tickets branch vs main) to attribute the growth — mirror the methodology used in f9ee.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Current `size-pack` for the exact CI checkout reproduced and attributed by object type / ref.
- [x] Root cause of the 08-23 crossing identified (growth event vs limit-too-low).
- [x] Either the limit is intentionally re-set with justification, or the growth is reclaimed so the gate is green, with evidence of a passing `Verify Authorship Identity` run.

## Evidence
- Failing run: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33253701193 (sha `5fb693345b0c`)
- Earlier same failure: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33239620291
- Limit source: `.github/workflows/verify-identity.yml:47` (`REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB: 102400`); guard at lines 62-63.

**AC completion evidence (see resolution comment 2026-08-29):** AC1/AC2 met by the Stage-1 dossier + Phase-1-exit RCA comments (481 MiB pack, ~90% tree objects; proven 08-23 organic growth step-change). AC3 met via the "limit intentionally re-set with justification" arm: budget raised 100→550 MiB by commit d0bcd6202789 (ticket a8ba, closed), restore tracked by 0894; passing run = Verify Authorship Identity scheduled run 33285210617 (sha 454f875e, 2026-08-30T01:14Z, success). Evidence is CI/history/cross-ticket (outside the code snapshot).
